page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s3 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. This instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing a direct physical-to-virtual core allocation. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core. The instance does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, and it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile of the ecs.s3.medium indicates a compute-focused resource distribution due to its low RAM-to-CPU ratio of 1:1. CPU instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA) are not available on this instance type. This configuration represents an entry-level dedicated compute resource, offering a predictable CPU allocation without the overhead of hyperthreading, which supports workloads requiring dedicated physical execution units but minimal memory footprints.

Given the 4.0 GB memory capacity and the absence of local storage, the ecs.s3.medium is suited for lightweight compute tasks, basic web serving, microservices, and distributed coordination nodes that do not require large memory allocations or high-performance local disk I/O. It is also applicable for utility computing, lightweight batch processing, and development environments where dedicated CPU execution is preferred over shared-core burstable instances.
